CPU_evidence.scope: Stdlib synthetic fixtures:5600successful checks versus old AST,truth/rejection,one truth evaluation,original exception identity,save error,durable failure on disk and explicit phase persistence. No Torch/model/real checkpoint/performance benchmark.

checks.false_condition: With the existing valid evidence.data dict/save interface, append message+phase to gate_failures, save, then raise RuntimeError(message). No false predicate can return success.
checks.integration_search: Current code tree references the new module only in its standalone test. No production import or monkeypatch was found in this read-only inspection.
checks.intentional_semantic_delta: Old helper saved before every truth test. New helper evaluates first, saves only on rejection/evaluation error and adds gate_failures. This preserves the acceptance predicate but intentionally changes successful I/O behavior. Callers must explicitly flush progress and completed-stage state.
checks.reference_integrity: Actual old J.require source852df835 and frozen AdamW source27fb9145 match receipt SHA; neither has been edited.
checks.save_error: Recording/save failure propagates, so it cannot be reported as durable evidence or a passed gate. As with the old helper, save error may take precedence over the rejection/condition exception; this exception is explicit.
checks.success: Normal Python truthiness tested once. True returns None with no evidence access, mutation or save. No finiteness/equality/threshold predicate is replaced or bypassed; caller still supplies the same check.
checks.truth_evaluation_exception: The original exception object/type is re-raised after diagnostics are saved, including BaseException-derived interruptions; no replacement RuntimeError hides a truth-evaluation error when recording succeeds.

limitations: Not yet integrated into a new consumer or NPU run. This review does not establish an end-to-end runtime fix or successful checkpoint continuation.
Success now deliberately produces no durable checkpoint; a new consumer must retain explicit phase/inventory/checkpoint/finally persistence and bound any incremental evidence writes.
The original AdamW run remains timed out and not accepted; no prior scientific or resource gate is relaxed.
